evidence: The quoted premises are present (settled-input.md lines 51, 86, 106 and 112), but the load-bearing premise that an independently recreated exact match with its ownership manifest retained must count as unmanaged/foreign is not established. The selected design explicitly chooses manifest-owned registrations (line 51), persists exact installed groups/fingerprints plus installation ID, and reuses an existing exact owned group (line 86). Its foreign-group rule applies to existing unmanaged identical groups; the scenario retains the management record and every exact recorded observation. I read the complete settled artifact and searched ownership, manifest, foreign, recreation, continuity, observation, fingerprints, identical groups, markers and limits; it supplies no stronger historical-origin guarantee making that retained-manifest match foreign. Demanding detection of an unobserved remove-and-byte-identical-recreate history therefore adds a continuity guarantee beyond the stated manifest/exact-match ownership contract. The indistinguishable histories are real, but do not demonstrate material violation or an undefined implementable policy under this spec.
